description: Department of Inland Revenue - Notify the fee to be charged in relation to an application for a private ruling requested by a tax payer
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal notice issued under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifically exercising powers vested by Section 107(7) to set a fee for a private ruling application. It pertains to the establishment of a regulatory requirement and falls squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" category for matters involving statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements.
